GeneDef.label: fleshling master
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a cancerous mass of semi-sentient flesh capable of creating a mindless duplicate of the carrier that will work.

customEffectDescriptions.li: <color=#8a8ae6>Every day</color>, creates a mutant-duplicate called a <color=#8a8ae6>fleshling</color>, up to 3.
Each <color=#8a8ae6>fleshling</color> can perform all jobs with <color=#8a8ae6>skill 8</color>, but cannot be leveled up.
Each pawn with this gene increases the colony's <color=#8a8ae6>fleshling limit</color> by 3.
